rationale: P identifies the braking behavior that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. H-3 establishes unintended braking, manifested as sudden stopping without an obstacle ahead, as the hazardous behavior; SG-3 directly requires its prevention. The declared scope matches H-3's operational situation. Braking is therefore itself the phenomenon being evaluated, not merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing requirements.
determining_elements: "Braking behavior of the ego vehicle" directly identifies the behavior addressed by H-3 and SG-3.
"Whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended" captures the occurrence and character of braking needed to evaluate T.
The scope—straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, in good weather—is supported by H-3.
